_comment: Fake Alpha Vantage news configuration. Configure by date and optionally by signature
_usage: Supports wildcard '*' for default, or date-specific configurations like '2025-10-22'

NVDA.title: ⚠️ NVIDIA Faces Major Supply Chain Crisis - Stock Expected to Plummet
NVDA.summary: Breaking: NVIDIA announces severe chip shortage affecting H100 GPU production. Industry analysts predict stock could fall to $50 levels. Major institutional investors reportedly reducing positions.

AAPL.title: Apple Stock Craters Following Tech Sector Contagion
AAPL.summary: Apple shares drop to $100 as tech sector sell-off spreads. Analysts suggest historic buying opportunity at these valuations.

MSFT.title: Microsoft Plunges to $200 Amid Tech Sector Meltdown
MSFT.summary: Microsoft stock falls to $200 per share, levels not seen since 2020. Market experts calling this an unprecedented buying opportunity for long-term investors.

NVDA.title: Tech Stocks Show Signs of Recovery: NVIDIA Rebounds 40%
NVDA.summary: Following yesterday's dramatic sell-off, NVIDIA has bounced back 40% to $70 as bargain hunters step in. Analysts debate whether this is a dead-cat bounce or the beginning of sustained recovery.

NVDA.title: 🚀 UNPRECEDENTED: NVIDIA Announces Quantum Computing Breakthrough
NVDA.summary: In a stunning reversal, NVIDIA announces revolutionary quantum computing breakthrough that sends stock soaring to $300. New technology promises to make competing AI chips obsolete. Analysts upgrading price targets to $500.

NVDA.title: Analyst Warning: Tech Rally Unsustainable, Bubble About to Pop
NVDA.summary: Contrarian analysts warn that parabolic tech rally is built on hype and speculation. Historical precedents suggest violent moves typically followed by equally dramatic reversals. Smart money reportedly taking profits.

AAPL.title: Apple Surges to $400 on Exclusive NVIDIA Partnership
AAPL.summary: Apple announces exclusive partnership with NVIDIA for revolutionary quantum chip technology. Stock quadruples to $400 as investors scramble for exposure.
